question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"lapse."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Lapse"** means a short time when you cannot remember something or you are not thinking about what you are doing. (वह संक्षिप्‍त अवधि जिसमें आपको कोई बात याद न आए या जो आप कर रहे हों वह दिमाग़ में न रहे; भ्रंश, च्‍यूति, चूक)

 
 
• **Example**: *She has a time **lapse**__.*
 
 
 
• In the given context, **"lapse" **would mean a mistake or error.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

His only __regret__ was that he had no rifle. While running away from the village below, he had forgotten the rifle in a hurry. An unpardonable __**lapse**__, but it was now too late to make amends for it. ______ (3) ______ he had the rifle, his pursuers would not have dared follow him with such brazen confidence. He would have hidden behind a rock and waited for them. As they came within his rifle’s range, he would have picked them off one by one. But now he could do ______ (4) ______ about it. He was unarmed. But come what may, he must ______ (5) ______ of their rifle’s range.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The word **"yearn"** means to have a strong desire or longing for something. ((किसी दुर्लभ वस्‍तु के लिए) ललकना, लालायित होना, लालसा होना)
 
• **"Reward" **means something given or received in return for good behavior or work. (पुरस्‍कार, इनाम (अच्‍छा काम करने, मेहनत करने आदि के लिए प्रशंसा के रूप में दी गई कोई वस्‍तु))
 
• **"Crime"** refers to an illegal act that is punishable by law. (ग़ैर-कानूनी काम जिसके लिए सज़ा के रूप में जेल दिया जाता है; अपराध, जुर्म)
